title: COBOL Quick Reference
description: Look up a lesson idea, see its small example, and check a common mistake. Open the linked lesson for setup and practice steps.

entries.name: Display a message
entries.summary: The procedure division holds steps. DISPLAY writes a value. STOP RUN ends the program.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.

procedure division.
DISPLAY "Hello, Asha!"
stop run.

notes: Compile these examples with -free because they use free-format source.

entries.name: Name a number
entries.summary: Working-storage holds data. PIC 9 describes one decimal digit.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PENCILS PIC 9 VALUE 3.
procedure division.
DISPLAY PENCILS
stop run.

notes: PIC 9 holds one digit; choose a wider picture for bigger numbers.

entries.name: Add to a count
entries.summary: ADD changes a numeric item by adding a value to it.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PENCILS PIC 9 VALUE 3.
procedure division.
ADD 2 TO PENCILS
DISPLAY PENCILS
stop run.

notes: Make sure the result fits the item picture.

entries.name: Work out a formula
entries.summary: COMPUTE assigns the result of a calculation.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 ANSWER PIC 9.
procedure division.
COMPUTE ANSWER = 3 * 2
DISPLAY ANSWER
stop run.

notes: A field that is too small can lose digits.

entries.name: Choose a message
entries.summary: IF checks a rule. END-IF marks where its branches finish.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 SCORE PIC 9 VALUE 8.
procedure division.
IF SCORE >= 5
 DISPLAY "Pass"
ELSE
 DISPLAY "Try again"
END-IF
stop run.

notes: End the conditional with END-IF before unrelated steps.

entries.name: Choose from several labels
entries.summary: EVALUATE selects steps by matching a value. WHEN OTHER is a fallback.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 LIGHT PIC X VALUE "G".
procedure division.
EVALUATE LIGHT
 WHEN "R" DISPLAY "Stop"
 WHEN "G" DISPLAY "Go"
 WHEN OTHER DISPLAY "Wait"
END-EVALUATE
stop run.

notes: Use a picture large enough for each label.

entries.name: Repeat with a counter
entries.summary: PERFORM VARYING updates a counter and repeats until its stop rule is true.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 N PIC 9.
procedure division.
PERFORM VARYING N FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL N > 3
 DISPLAY N
END-PERFORM
stop run.

notes: Check that the counter changes toward the stopping rule.

entries.name: Read a table item
entries.summary: OCCURS makes repeated data items. Subscripts start at 1 in COBOL.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 SCORES.
 05 SCORE PIC 9 OCCURS 3 TIMES.
procedure division.
MOVE 4 TO SCORE(1)
MOVE 5 TO SCORE(2)
MOVE 8 TO SCORE(3)
DISPLAY SCORE(2)
stop run.

notes: A table subscript must stay within its declared count.

entries.name: Store a name
entries.summary: PIC X describes a character. A number in parentheses gives the field length.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 STUDENT-NAME PIC X(4) VALUE "Asha".
procedure division.
DISPLAY STUDENT-NAME
stop run.

notes: Longer text needs a larger field or it will be cut short.

entries.name: Change text case
entries.summary: UPPER-CASE is a built-in function that makes letters uppercase.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.

procedure division.
DISPLAY FUNCTION UPPER-CASE("asha")
stop run.

notes: Call this with FUNCTION before the function name.

entries.name: Measure a text field
entries.summary: LENGTH gives the declared length of this text field, including any spaces.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
data division.
working-storage section.
01 PET PIC X(3) VALUE "cat".
01 SIZE-NUM PIC 9.
procedure division.
COMPUTE SIZE-NUM = FUNCTION LENGTH(PET)
DISPLAY SIZE-NUM
stop run.

notes: Field length includes padding spaces; it is not always the typed word length.

entries.name: Name a group of steps
entries.summary: A paragraph labels a group of steps. PERFORM runs that paragraph and returns.

example.code:
identification division.
program-id. lesson.
procedure division.
PERFORM GREET
STOP RUN.
GREET.
DISPLAY "Hello again".

notes: STOP RUN before paragraph definitions prevents accidental fall-through at the end.
